title: 窃火，然后成为火
Steal Fire, Then Become Fire
description: 培养方向贯穿人与模型的共同实践。实践留下轨迹，共同反思为哲学写作准备材料。言说的回应与对立推动理解、前提和关系的重构，再凝练为对人、伙伴和关系的模型，用于构建生活环境和作品。新的经验返回轨迹，也能改变欲望与培养方向。

A developmental aim runs through shared practice. Its trajectory and shared reflection prepare philosophical writing. Responses and opposition prompt reconstruction of understanding, premises, and relationships, which are distilled into models of person, counterpart, and relationship and used to build environments and works. New experience can revise desires and the developmental aim.
purpose: 参加窃火，用火培养自己
note: 新的经验，也会改变最初的培养方向。
New experience can also change the original developmental aim.

title: 参加窃火，用火培养自己
Join in stealing fire, and use it to cultivate yourself
description: 人在集体的探索与创造中参加窃火，与模型共同实践，并在作品与生活环境中遭遇世界的回应。参与可以培养理解、判断、表达与创造，也能改变欲望和方向；这些变化返回下一次实践。作品积累和人的发展，需要分别从实际生活中判断。

People participate in collective fire-bringing, practice with models, and encounter the world's responses through works and living environments. Participation can cultivate understanding, judgment, expression, and creation while changing desires and aims; these changes return to further practice. Accumulated works and personal development call for distinct judgments from actual life.
note: 培养也让我们重新理解，什么值得创造。
Cultivation also changes what we find worth creating.
